## Handout 4 — The Tribune's Sealed Orders {.unnumbered}

*Give when Tribune Lucius presents his credentials to the Legate. Let a player break the seal.*

<div class="handout-block">

<div class="handout-label">Handout 4</div>

## Senatus Populusque Romanus

By authority of the Senate and the consulship of Lucius Fulvius Rufus and Marcus Plautius Quintillus:

Tribune Lucius Valerius Maximus is hereby empowered to act in the Senate's name in all matters pertaining to the artifact recovered at Fort Vindolanda.

All military personnel are ordered to render full assistance. The Legate's command is suspended pending senatorial review.

<hr class="handout-divider">

*In nomine Senatus Populique Romani*

</div>

---

## Handout 5 — A Letter Found in the Tribune's Quarters {.unnumbered}

*Give only when players successfully search the Tribune's quarters. Hand it folded. Do not read it aloud. Let them decode it.*

<div class="handout-block">

<div class="handout-label">Handout 5</div>

*The paper is cheap — cheaper than the Tribune's other correspondence. It has been folded twice and shows signs of having been carried a long way. The handwriting is deliberate, each letter formed with care.*

<hr class="handout-divider">

<div class="cipher-text">Cqn arcrxvpe expde: Aqr xqrjxbqe jcbq. Dkb jcbq xrrno Kbc. Dkb jcbq eba Kbe kbbi ecba kbi. Ebo jcbq. Ebo rea ebo. M.J.E.</div>

<hr class="handout-divider">

<div class="handout-note">On the back, in faint pencil: <em>shift 3</em></div>

</div>
